title: The NFL injury report re-renders club records after kickoff
detail: The Monday section read on 2026-11-17 printed 'LAC Chargers (0-8) @ BAL Ravens (4-5)'; the same rows read on 2026-11-18 print 'LAC Chargers (1-8) @ BAL Ravens (4-6)'. Player rows are identical. A capture taken after kickoff is therefore contaminated by the result.
action: Capture only before kickoff; never use the record field as a pre-game feature.

title: A player published as Out started the game
detail: The Chargers' Branson Taylor is published Out (ankle, did not practise) on the Week 10 report, but the official Game Book lists L.Taylor (65) as the starting left guard and does not place him on the Not Active list. Name matching is by surname, so the identity is not resolved by this desk - it is flagged.
action: Resolve with a jersey-number join once an official roster with numbers is captured; do not silently drop the row.

title: Baltimore's substitution list is truncated in the read
detail: The Game Book substitution block for Baltimore is cut mid-list at 'NT 94' by the rendered chunk boundary; one entry is cut mid-row. Starters, Did Not Play and Not Active lists for both clubs were read in full.
action: Re-capture the Game Book in full before substitutions are used in any count.

title: No Week 11 injury baseline exists at read time
detail: On Wednesday 2026-11-18 the URL /injuries/league/2026/REG11 resolves to the Week 10 report. No Week 11 row is transcribed; nothing is inferred from the Week 10 report for Week 11.
action: Capture Wednesday, Thursday and Friday as three separate immutable snapshots once publication begins.

title: The Minnesota at San Francisco venue is not printed on the Week 11 page
detail: The schedule page renders a 'Mexico City 2026' event logo immediately above the Sunday-night block containing Vikings at 49ers, but prints no stadium for that game in the chunks read. The venue is left blank rather than inferred.
action: Read the game centre page for that fixture after publication and fill the cell from it.

title: nfl.com publishes no inactive list at /inactives/
detail: The page is titled 'NFL Inactives | Inactive Players' but its body reads 'Please check back soon for NFL Inactive Reports for this Season' on a Wednesday of an active season.
action: Keep using the official Game Book Not Active block as the source; re-probe the page each season.

title: Game Book copyright notice restricts reuse
detail: Every Game Book carries: 'This summary and play-by-play is for the express purpose of assisting media in their coverage of the game; any other use of this material is prohibited without the written permission of the National Football League.' This desk publishes derived counts and links only.
action: Keep raw captures out of the public site until the terms are read.
